# Probed Erlang/OTP + Elixir numeric semantics the oracle relies on.
# Generated by gen-vectors.exs. Cross-platform-exact EXCEPT where noted
# (the :math.pow probe and anything else touching libm).

## Kernel.round/1 (ties away from zero)
round(0.5) = 1
round(1.5) = 2
round(2.5) = 3
round(-0.5) = -1
round(-1.5) = -2
round(132.25) = 132
round(132.5) = 133

## Float.round/2 — operates on the EXACT binary value; ties (reachable only at dyadic tie points) away from zero
Float.round(0.125, 2) = 0.13
Float.round(0.375, 2) = 0.38
Float.round(-0.125, 2) = -0.13
Float.round(0.0625, 3) = 0.063
Float.round(2.5, 0) = 3.0
Float.round(0.5, 0) = 1.0
Float.round(1.5, 0) = 2.0
Float.round(2.675, 2) = 2.67
Float.round(0.285, 2) = 0.28
Float.round(1.005, 2) = 1.0
Float.round(0.0078125, 6) = 0.007813
Float.round(0.0703125, 6) = 0.070313
Float.round(-0.0078125, 6) = -0.007813
Float.round(27.272727272727273, 3) = 27.273
Float.round(-27.272727272727273, 3) = -27.273
Float.round(0.0272727272727272, 3) = 0.027
Float.round(1.0e-7, 6) = 0.0
Float.round(0.9999995, 6) = 1.0
Float.round(166.66666666666669, 3) = 166.667
Float.round(0.6666666666666666, 2) = 0.67

## :erlang.float_to_binary(x, [:compact, decimals: 6]) — the JSONL float format
ftb(0.0) = 0.0
ftb(-0.0) = -0.0
ftb(1.0) = 1.0
ftb(0.95) = 0.95
ftb(-0.15) = -0.15
ftb(27.273) = 27.273
ftb(27.273000000000003) = 27.273
ftb(5.04e-4) = 0.000504
ftb(123.4567891) = 123.456789
ftb(1.0e-7) = 0.0
ftb(-1.0e-7) = -0.0
ftb(0.9999995) = 1.0
ftb(0.99999949) = 0.999999
ftb(2.6449999999999996) = 2.645
ftb(5.885532879818594) = 5.885533
ftb(100.0) = 100.0
ftb(0.25) = 0.25
ftb(-4.0) = -4.0
ftb(5.0e-7) = 0.000001
ftb(1.5e-6) = 0.000002
ftb(2.5e-6) = 0.000003
ftb(2.675) = 2.675
ftb(0.285) = 0.285
ftb(0.0078125) = 0.007813
ftb(0.0703125) = 0.070313
ftb(-0.0078125) = -0.007813

## :erlang.float_to_binary at 2 decimals (documents exact-binary-value rounding generally)
ftb2(2.675) = 2.67
ftb2(0.285) = 0.28
ftb2(1.005) = 1.0
ftb2(0.125) = 0.13

## Float.parse/1 (num! strips all leading '+' first, then requires full match)
Float.parse("58") = {58.0, ""}
Float.parse("58.") = {58.0, "."}
Float.parse(".5") = :error
Float.parse("1e3") = {1000.0, ""}
Float.parse("1.0e3") = {1000.0, ""}
Float.parse("-0.02") = {-0.02, ""}
Float.parse("+5") = {5.0, ""}
Float.parse("0") = {0.0, ""}
Float.parse("1_000") = {1.0, "_000"}
Float.parse("0x10") = {0.0, "x10"}
Float.parse("++5") = :error

## Integer.parse/1 (one optional sign accepted; int! does no extra stripping)
Integer.parse("42") = {42, ""}
Integer.parse("-0") = {0, ""}
Integer.parse("+2") = {2, ""}
Integer.parse("3.5") = {3, ".5"}
Integer.parse("1_000") = {1, "_000"}
Integer.parse("16") = {16, ""}
Integer.parse("++2") = :error

## two's-complement masking of seeds (Bitwise.band(seed, 2^64-1))
band(-1, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) = 18446744073709551615
band(-2, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) = 18446744073709551614
band(18446744073709551616, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) = 0

## trunc/1 (toward zero) — frame placement & buffer lengths
trunc(2.9999999) = 2
trunc(0.5 * 44100) = 22050
trunc(0.30 * 44100) = 13230
trunc(0.22 * 44100) = 9702
trunc(0.075 * 44100) = 3307
trunc(0.26 * 44100) = 11466
trunc(0.45 * 44100) = 19845
trunc(0.011 * 44100) = 485
trunc(0.023 * 44100) = 1014
trunc(0.008 * 44100) = 352

## Integer.floor_div / rem
Integer.floor_div(-7, 2) = -4
Integer.floor_div(7, 2) = 3
rem(-1, 5) = -1
rem(7, 5) = 2

## max(0.0, -0.0) sign (the performed_s clamp)
float_to_binary(max(0.0, -0.0), [:short]) = 0.0

## Range 0..-1 under Enum (the bars=0 / n_steps=0 pathology)
Enum.to_list(0..-1) = [0, -1]
Enum.at([10, 20, 30], -1) = 30

## u64 -> f64 conversion then /2^64 (flt output stage; conversion rounds to nearest-even)
18446744073709551615 / 2^64 = 1.0
9007199254740993 / 2^64 = 4.8828125e-4
6148914691236517205 / 2^64 = 0.3333333333333333

## :math.pow on negatives (negative vel at render time)
pow(-0.39, 1.5) raises Elixir.ArithmeticError
